name: AI Litigation
blurb: Living case pages for AI lawsuits in United States courts, refreshed from the dockets daily.

built.name: AI Lawsuit Tracker
built.detail: Living case pages for AI lawsuits in United States courts, with docket timelines refreshed daily from CourtListener. Every case is labeled by claim family: copyright, right of publicity, product liability and wrongful death, hiring discrimination, biometric privacy, securities fraud, trade secrets, platform access, patent, consumer protection, and government contracts.

built.name: AI Case Law: The Precedents Behind the Defenses
built.detail: The older decisions AI defendants are actually relying on. Every current AI copyright, scraping and defamation case is argued out of a small set of precedents decided long before generative models existed: Sony on substantial non-infringing use, Campbell and Google Books on transformative purpose, Van Buren and hiQ on scraping, Zeran on Section 230. Each profile states what the case held, why AI defendants cite it, and where the analogy is weakest, with a link to the opinion itself.
